name: Vera'erius the Brave

facts.text: Level 68, 30,000 health. Spirit and Body damage heal him; at 70% health he casts Vera'erius Heal (400) on himself.

The drakoran of the city come in five clans whose names echo their lords': drau'gyn (Dra'argus), dry'ak (Dura'ek), syhr'phint (Sys'sro), vyr'em (Vera'erius) and wi'voron (Weno'iak); the lords' linked packs are of their own clan. The clan reading is inferred from names and packs.

story: Vera'erius leads the vyr'em, the swordsmen of the drakoran, and of all the five lords he is the one Albion's knights respect, because he fights at the front of his clan and asks no one to take a blow he would not take himself. The vyr'em say he cannot be killed by sorcery, and in a way they are right: the spells that wither and those that strike at the spirit only mend him. When he is hurt he heals himself and keeps coming. He is brave because nothing has ever given him cause to be otherwise.
legend: Spirit and body damage heal him. Bring steel and the other elements. At seventy percent he heals himself, so burn through it. A straight fight otherwise, and the most honourable of the five lords; his swordsmen will not interfere unless you pull them.

aggro: Face me, then. Steel to steel!

phases.text: Not yet! The vyr'em do not fall so easily!

death: A good death... at the front...
slay: You fought well. It was not enough.
